verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Cline publishes a live llms.txt at docs.cline.bot. Its doc pages are also served as markdown, each with a header pointing agents to the llms.txt documentation index, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining the llms.txt/markdown docs offering, evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (probe content is truncated).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.cline.bot/llms.txt
